stem:
Ayaan walks through a forest with dense herbs, shrubs and trees, and sees birds, insects and deer living there.

Why is this forest more than just a group of trees?

options.text: A few scattered plants count as a forest whenever they give animals some food.
Forests grow dense plants only after animals first decide they need food and shelter there.
Dense, varied plant growth provides food and shelter, so many animals, birds and insects can live there together.
Any patch of green plants is the same kind of forest home because it is green.

teacher.key_rationale: A forest is an ecosystem-like home because dense, varied plants provide food and shelter for many life forms. Scattered plants, reversing who comes first, or green colour alone do not make that home.
